label: For "Shop-Floor Agent Action Guardrails": Keep AI agents inside safe limits when they touch recipes, work orders and machine parameters on the shop floor, and give quality and safety teams a trustworthy record of every change. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Plant-wide write rights.
